title: Binary field linear solver backend
statement: A binary-field linear solver backend assigns a solver and a natural-number work count to each finite, decidable-equality, encodable coordinate type and each finite list of linear equations over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The solver returns an element of $\mathbb{F}_2$ for every coordinate. Whenever the list of equations has a satisfying assignment, the backend's returned assignment satisfies every equation in the list.
hypotheses_covered: Equality on the coordinate type is decidable
The equations are a finite list
Whenever a satisfying assignment exists, the solver's assignment satisfies every listed equation
